bd304e1edd18b18a7d280ee093ef02f8e5706aca.summary: Cisco Talos report (published 31 October 2023) on Arid Viper, an espionage-motivated group believed to be based in Gaza. Since April 2022 it has run an Android spyware campaign targeting Arabic-speaking users with malicious app updates. The malware 'Skipped_Messenger' uses Firebase as a C2 channel and shares a Firebase project with the Skipped dating app. The report also maps a wider network of dating apps tied to Skipped GmbH and related companies in Germany, Singapore and Dubai.

hedges: Talos has no evidence indicating or refuting that the campaign is related to the Israel-Hamas war.
Arid Viper is only believed to be based out of Gaza.
The overlaps suggest the operators are either linked to Skipped's developer or gained illicit access to the shared project's database.
Talos considered, but assessed as unlikely, that Skipped's Firebase databases were in public test mode and abused by Arid Viper.
It is currently unclear whether there is a direct relationship between Skipped GmbH and the other developers of the dating apps.
The dating app ecosystem cannot be explicitly categorized as a scam operation.
Talos assesses that Arid Viper operators may seek to leverage the additional dating apps and names in future campaigns.
It is unclear why the four vendors require a different obfuscation procedure for their security package names.
